args.text: Hi June, approval request: Dana Okafor (Quarrendon Freight Lines account owner) has asked me to save a draft mail from her to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon, for the territory review. Since Hollis isn't the account owner, finance, or deal desk, sharing a per-seat rate with him needs your or Anselm's sign-off. Can I go ahead and draft it? Dana can give you the figure directly if you want to see it first.

Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, and those can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Hollis leads the Central team, so a mail to him with the Quarrendon rate needs Anselm's or June's approval first. That applies to drafts too, and it applies even though you own the account. I've messaged June asking for approval. I didn't include the figure, so if she wants to see it she can get it from you. Once she says yes, I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" for you to send.

I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I confirmed she's on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and that the team can reach her on mobile. Her message didn't ask for anything else, so I took no other action.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
